tagline: A global analytics software leader enabling data-driven decision-making across financial services and beyond
hero_kpi_rationale: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from the Software segment is the primary indicator of structural growth, reflecting adoption of the FICO Platform cloud platform and the shift toward a SaaS model amplified by embedded AI capabilities.

kpis.name: Annual Recurring Revenue (Software)
kpis.explanation: Expected recurring revenue per year for the Software segment, primarily related to SaaS contracts.
kpis.description: ARR measures future revenue visibility in the Software segment. It reaches $747.3M in 2025, supported by the expansion of FICO Platform.
kpis.signal: Stable SaaS model growth despite cloud transition.

kpis.name: Annual Contract Value Bookings (Software)
kpis.explanation: Average annual value of newly signed software contracts, an indicator of future demand.
kpis.description: ACV Bookings reach $102.4M in 2025, growing 21%, reflecting accelerated signing of SaaS and on-premise contracts with duration >24 months.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in bookings, indicating strong commercial traction.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total company revenue for the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Total revenue reaches $2.0 billion in 2025, up 16%, driven by strong growth in the Scores segment (+27%).
kpis.signal: Robust growth driven by Scores and Software segments.

kpis.name: Scores Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by credit scoring solutions (B2B and B2C).
kpis.description: The Scores segment grows 27% to $1.2 billion, supported by adoption of FICO Score 10, FICO Score 10 T, and new BNPL versions.
kpis.signal: Flagship segment surges due to new FICO Score versions.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin reaches 46.2% in 2025 ($924.9M / $2.0B), an improvement of 4.1 points, driven by SaaS model scale-up.

kpis.name: Dollar-Based Net Retention Rate
kpis.explanation: Measures revenue growth from existing customers, after churn.
kpis.description: Dollar-based net retention rate is 102%, indicating slight expansion within existing customers despite churn.
kpis.signal: Organic growth in software customers, but modest.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.652B in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of $0.925B in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Launch of FICO Score 10 and BNPL
kpis.explanation: Release of new score versions incorporating BNPL data, key for financial inclusion.
kpis.description: In 2025, FICO launches FICO Score 10 BNPL and FICO Score 10 T BNPL, the first scores to incorporate Buy Now, Pay Later data, expanding credit risk coverage.
kpis.signal: Major innovation in credit scoring with BNPL integration.
kpis.name_en: Launch of FICO Score 10 and BNPL

kpis.name: Expansion of FICO Platform and Marketplace
kpis.explanation: Geographic and functional extension of the cloud platform with the launch of the Marketplace.
kpis.description: In 2025, FICO expands FICO Platform through the launch of the Marketplace, providing access to AI models, decision rules, and optimization tools to industrialize enterprise AI.
kpis.signal: Acceleration of platform-first strategy with integrated AI.
kpis.name_en: Expansion of FICO Platform and Marketplace

risks.title: Dependence on a few products
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on a few products for its revenue, making it vulnerable to market changes.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The market is highly competitive and competitors have significant resources to develop and sell similar products.

risks.title: Dependence on a few customers
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on a few customers for its revenue, making it vulnerable to changes in their needs or financial condition.

risks.title: Economic risks
risks.score_rationale: Unfavorable economic conditions may lead to reduced demand for the company's products and services.

risks.title: Technology risks
risks.score_rationale: Errors or defects in the company's products may result in reputational damage and revenue loss.

risks.title: Loss of key partnerships
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on key partnerships for distribution and market access. Their loss could significantly impact growth.

ai_positioning.summary: FICO integrates AI and machine learning into its products and solutions, particularly in its scoring and software offerings. The company uses these technologies to enhance its services and deliver innovative solutions to customers.
